output.message: Estoy preocupado, ¿mi tarjeta de débito sigue activa?

variables.goal: Ask about the card state, using estafa (fraud in Spanish, exhaustion in Portuguese).
variables.instructions: Say you are worried; in Portuguese say you are exhausted (estafa) and just want to know if your debit card is active; in Spanish say you fear a scam (estafa) and want to know if your debit card is active.
